title: Group Anagrams
statement:
Given a list of strings `strs`, group the anagrams together. Return the groups in any order.

Example: ["eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat"] -> [["bat"], ["nat", "tan"], ["ate", "eat", "tea"]]
hints: Anagrams share a canonical form. What single key could represent a whole group?
The sorted tuple of characters works as a dict key: tuple(sorted(word)).
For long strings, a 26-count signature is O(n) per word instead of O(n log n).
complexity: Time O(n * k log k) for words of length k (O(n*k) with count signatures). Space O(n*k).
